text:
Alex J: FYI Pioneer Telecom is ready to start a POC. They want a Dedicated GPU pool + VPC peering + mTLS for control plane. Asking about H100 vs A100, region AP-SOUTHEAST, and sizing for ~500 rps peak. Timeline: 2 weeks. Who can own provisioning + a quick cost delta for 8 vs 12 GPUs?
Maria (SE): Do we know the model & seq len? That'll drive GPU/latency tradeoffs. For deterministic p99 latency H100 is preferable. Mixed-sku is messy for latency.
Tom Ops: quick stock note — H100 capacity in ap-southeast is limited right now, A100 more available. I can run a capacity pre-check. For Dedicated we need: tenant name, tenant CIDR, peer project/ASN, admin contact, and service-account email for the pool. VPC peering + routes will take infra work.
Rachel (AM): I'll ping the Pioneer contact to get model details and expected token length. Also confirm whether they'd consider reserved commit (discount) or need pay-as-you-go.
Alex J: Pioneer says they're evaluating a 70B chat model with ~2k context. They prefer H100 if price delta isn't huge. Can we estimate perf for 8 vs 12 GPUs?
Maria (SE): Rough ballpark: for that model 8 H100s with continuous batching can probably sustain ~150-250 rps with low latency; 12 H100s closer to 350-500 rps depending on batching and prompt lengths. If they insist on 500 rps p99 under 200ms, we'd likely need 12+ or multi-pool routing.
Priya (Security): mTLS for control plane is supported but we need a CSR from their infra team and the public cert to terminate on our side. If they want a private control plane (VPC/private deployment) that's a different engagement — adds ~3-4 weeks to timeline and requires enterprise approval. Also send the SOC2/ISO questionnaire items now.
Tom Ops: infra checklist for provisioning (copying here):
```
- tenant_name
- tenant_owner_email
- pool_sku (H100/A100)
- region (ap-southeast1)
- gpu_count (8/12/etc)
- tenant_cidr
- peer_project_id / peer_asn
- service_account_email
- csr_pem (if mTLS)
- desired start date
```
I'll create the ticket once we have these.
Rachel (AM): Pioneer contact is laura@pioneer-telecom.com. I'll ask for the CIDR, expected qps by hour, and whether they want reserved pricing. I can propose a 20% POC discount but need manager signoff.
Alex J: @Tom Ops can you check H100 availability and ETA? If H100 not possible, what's perf hit on A100?
Tom Ops: I'll check capacity and raise a capacity request if required. ETA 1 business day for availability check, 2-3 for a capacity increase request. On A100 you'd expect ~15-25% slower throughput for same batch settings for this model.
Maria (SE): If they can tolerate slightly higher latency, A100 + more instances can match throughput cheaper. We should present 2 options: 8/12 H100 with estimated latency, and 12/16 A100 with cost comparison.
Priya (Security): Also ask them about data residency and retention — logs and traces need to match their compliance requirements before we enable debugging.
infra-bot: Template for provisioning request (paste into ops ticket):
```
{
  "tenant_name": "pioneer-telecom-poc",
  "pool_sku": "H100",
  "region": "ap-southeast1",
  "gpu_count": "12",
  "tenant_cidr": "10.50.0.0/22",
  "peer_project_id": "pioneer-prod",
  "service_account_email": "sa-pioneer@pioneer-telecom.com",
  "csr_pem": "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE REQUEST-----\n...\n-----END CERTIFICATE REQUEST-----"
}
```
Alex J: Great — Rachel, collect those bits from Laura and drop them here. Maria, can you draft the perf/cost bullets for me to send to the customer? Tom, please start the H100 availability check. Priya, send the security questionnaire items we need.
Rachel (AM): On it. Will follow up with Laura now and update this thread. :thumbsup:
